???+ remember "Before you start, remember"

    ??? question "Which MLIR type names a shaped, typed reference to a region of memory, with a layout such as row-major order?"

        A memref. It behaves like a Vortex `&mut` argument, except that nothing in the type itself rules out two memrefs aliasing.

        Introduced in [M2. Reading MLIR](m2-reading-mlir.md).

    ??? question "What do we call a family of operations, types and attributes that MLIR ships as one unit, such as linalg or arith?"

        A dialect. One MLIR module can mix several dialects at once, all handled by the same parser, verifier and printer.

        Introduced in [M1. Why MLIR](m1-why-mlir.md).

    ??? question "What do we call one trip over the whole program by one part of the compiler, doing one job?"

        A pass, such as checking types or lowering to IR.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 6. The first machine code](../compiler/guide/stage-6-first-machine-code.md).
